desc: Implement full-integer BFS XOR-potential solution with contradiction detection and per-component per-bit optimal root selection (iterative, fast IO)
Handle edge cases: M=0 (all zeros), self-loops with Z!=0 (=> -1), multiple/duplicate contradictory edges, disconnected components, bits above max Z set to 0
Run the program on Samples 1-3 and verify outputs are valid good sequences with minimum sum (Sample 2 must print -1)
Verify correctness via reasoning about per-bit independence and per-component free root r
